name: Photo-Vector Mashup
description: Using vector elements to enhance a photograph. I struggled with this project- I was inspired by futuristic and heavier graphics from Cyberpunk and upcoming game Marathon, but I also wanted to maintain a light and colorful vibe. If I were to go back in time I would have tried to stick to a lane a bit more, either leaning into the militaristic dystopian cybernetic aesthetic, or lean into the more playful feel. I think the harsh polygonal shapes are neat, though, and would benefit from a more 'harsh' color palette. The rough-hewn outlines were vaguely inspired by my beloved Spider-Punk.
